lessonPractice.title: 可拖动卡片、文字输入框和禁用按钮现在都显示同一种小手指针。怎样修正？

options.label: 按真实角色分别使用 grab、text 和 not-allowed，并保留清楚的控件样式
options.feedback: 指针与操作类型一致能提前提示行为，但控件本身仍需表达可拖、可输入或禁用。

options.label: 继续全部使用 pointer，让用户知道这些区域都值得关注
options.feedback: Pointer 通常暗示点击，无法区分拖动、文本输入和不可用状态，反而制造错误预期。

options.label: 移除按钮和输入框的视觉差异，只依靠鼠标指针说明功能
options.feedback: 触屏没有鼠标变化，指针也只是辅助线索，不能替代控件的可见角色和状态。

en.title: A draggable card, text field, and disabled button all show the same hand cursor. How should this be corrected?

options.label: Use grab, text, and not-allowed by actual role while keeping clear control styling
options.feedback: Role-matched cursors preview behavior, while the controls themselves still communicate drag, input, and disabled state.

options.label: Keep pointer everywhere so users know all three regions deserve attention
options.feedback: Pointer usually implies clicking and cannot distinguish dragging, text input, and unavailable actions.

options.label: Remove visual differences between controls and rely only on cursor shape for meaning
options.feedback: Touch has no cursor change, and a cursor is only a secondary cue rather than a visible role or state.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查页面 cursor：可点击控件使用符合现有规范的 pointer，文本输入显示 text，拖拽手柄显示 grab/grabbing，禁用操作显示 not-allowed。指针只作辅助，触屏下仍要靠界面样式看懂功能。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Audit cursor usage: follow the product convention for clickable controls, use text for input, grab and grabbing for drag handles, and not-allowed for disabled actions. Treat cursors as secondary cues and preserve meaning on touch.

entry.prompt_en: Check whether the mouse pointers on this page match the actual interactions. Review buttons and links, text fields, draggable cards, and disabled actions separately; do not add custom image cursors. Then hover each area with a mouse and tell me what you changed.
